title: Meta Sued Over Training Data for Its AI and Face-Recognition Systems
what_happened: The proposed class action alleges Meta illegally harvested people’s Facebook and Instagram photos to train its AI image-generation models and to build its unreleased “NameTag” face recognition feature.
primary_risk: Regulatory exposure and erosion of public trust due to opaque data practices.
primary_opportunity: Differentiation through auditable, privacy-preserving AI pipelines.
technical_angle: Trust, not model size, is becoming a core technical constraint in AI systems.
